title: fix(scenarios): load the card seed through the platform's seed path
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQ3DFv6XZAspQRYGQoEWhr8)_

Fixes #34897

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景卡运行器不再用数据 API 逐行写入种子数据,改为把卡片种子打成一个只含 `data[]` 的包,经托管安装门交给平台自己的种子加载器写入;恢复已删除种子行也走同一条路。
- 为什么改:构建按 skill 指引声明了 `initialStates: ['draft']` 的状态机,数据 API 属于用户写入,于是 travel_expense 卡 120 张报销单中 114 张(已付款/已提交等)被拒,其下 470 条明细与审批步骤连带被拒,584/757 行丢失,问数轮次在错误的数据上进行。
- 风险与回滚:种子行不再触发构建的记录触发流(平台种子语义如此);已普查 9 张卡,没有一张的答案依赖种子时触发流。拒收记录不再带错误码,只有加载器原文。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 的 `loadSeedRows` 与 `seedApp`(风险最高:错误清单到拒收记录的映射);同文件 `restoreSeededRows` 第 2 步;`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` 新增的 `TravelRulesApp` 一组用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t "past its entry state"`,预期 6 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `seedApp` builds one dataset per object in its existing load order (the card's own `id` on each row; persona user ids, `owner_id` and rewritten handles as before; deferred cycle lookups still left out) and hands them to a new module-private `loadSeedRows`.
- `loadSeedRows` installs a data-only package (`data[]`, `externalId: 'id'`, `mode: 'insert'`, its own namespace per load) through the harness's existing `installManaged` door. The platform's seed loader writes package data under `SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT`: the `state_machine` rule is skipped, every other rule and hook still runs, and record-change flows are suppressed. It maps the answer's `data.seeded.errorList` into the same `seed.refused` records: one per row the loader could not write, plus `fields` for a written row whose reference did not resolve. A refused package, a harness with no managed door, or a load that did not run inline refuses every row, with the reason.
- The second pass (PATCH of the lookups that close a reference cycle) is unchanged.
- `restoreSeededRows` step 2 re-inserts the round's missing seeded rows as one load through the same path.
- No exported signature or type changes: the harness interface gains no member, and the new helpers are module-private. The `installManaged` doc comment and the door table in `app.ts` say the seed loads through it.
- README: the Seed paragraph names the door and the posture. It states that seed rows fire no record-triggered flow and that no card relies on one.
- Test doubles: both `FakeApp`s give the managed door the measured answer shape (`test/runner/seed-door.ts`).

### Route A, and one place the mechanism moved

The seat ruled route A: load the rows as declared `data[]` under the seed posture, and keep the PATCH pass for runtime-id fields. I measured that assumption before building (condition 1, below). `data[]` carries runtime user ids as sent: `owner_id` and the `user` field landed, and the persona read its own 10 claims (M3). The seat then ruled on that deviation (A, 21:58Z): persona ids ride in the load, and the PATCH pass now sets only the deferred cycle lookups. Re-patching the persona ids would put a user-door update, with its update triggers and hooks, back on every persona-owned seed row, and the seed posture exists to avoid exactly that. The README's Seed paragraph says the same.

## Tests

- New block `seedApp — a card row already past its entry state loads through the seed path…`, run on the travel_expense card with a double of the kept build's rules (`TravelRulesApp`):
  - the user door refuses a paid claim;
  - through `seedApp`, all 757 rows load: 114 non-draft claims, and `ln_001_hotel` / `as_001_1` hold `claim: 'c001'`;
  - control: a trip that breaks `end_after_start` is refused with the loader's message and no code, and its claim, two lines and two steps go with it (751 inserted);
  - `restoreSeededRows` puts a removed paid claim back;
  - a reference the loader drops from a row it wrote (an `errorList` entry whose `field` is the lookup): the row is refused with `fields: ['parent']`, `inserted` drops by one (755), and its deferred `manager` patch still runs (`secondPass` 3); a row with both a write entry and a reference entry counts once, without `fields`; and a restore counts the written row as reinserted. The double (`test/runner/seed-door.ts`) can now drop a reference from a row it writes, as the real loader reports one (`referencesDropped`).
  - a harness with no managed door refuses every row, saying so.
- Updated: the partial-tally test (one load, which throws, counts nothing); two refusal expectations now read the loader's message and no code; the fresh-copy seed-difference regex; `UnmanagedOnly` now drops the managed door explicitly.

## Gates and test runs (head 1c5dbc3a45)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && … test && … typecheck`, under the verify lock: `Test Files 39 passed (39)`, `Tests 1092 passed (1092)`, typecheck clean, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- S1 round (1c5dbc3a45, two commits: a README sentence and the S1 test): the package run above is on this head. The README path derives 42 gate families and the two test paths add 7; all exit 0 except the two standing NOT MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, both exit 3). `overlap-check`: VERDICT clean exit 0.
- Derived gate list: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` gives 67 families at 81b6323e86. That is the same list as on the earlier head. The reconciliation (`--ran` with each exit code captured before any pipe) reads `67 derived, 65 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- `pnpm check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` was red on the first head. It flagged a refusal helper that took a `code` parameter it could not name as a literal. 81b6323e86 removes it: a refused seed package now puts the door's code in the message. The gate was re-run on that tree and exited 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`. It exited 3 because the shallow clone lacks the commit it needs ("Deepen the clone"). The scan itself, `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs`, exited 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. It exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: other packages have no `dist/` in this worktree. CI builds them and runs it.
- Not run locally: `test:repo` and the repo-wide scans. Both belong to CI.

<details><summary>Ablation: the seed path and the restore path, one leg each</summary>

The scenarios tests import the runner from `src/` by relative path, so neither leg needs a dist rebuild. Each leg was written with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` from the HEAD blob `a8c96bc92dd1` of `orchestrate.ts` and restored the same way. After each restore, the blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

- Leg 1: the seed loop goes back to one data-API insert per row (blob `a8c96bc92dd1 -> 1ff43a1b3708`, anchor 1 -> 0). 4 of the 5 new tests go red: all 757 load, the control, the restore (its seed already failed) and the missing-door case. The user-door test stays green, as it should.
- Leg 2: only the restore re-insert goes back to the data API (blob `a8c96bc92dd1 -> 0aaa6d7a3034`). Only the restore test goes red: `failed: … demotravel_expense_claim: 1 missing (c001) (refused: insert demotravel_expense_claim c001: This status change is not allowed; a paid claim cannot be changed.)`.
- Leg 3 (S1, head 1c5dbc3a45): the reference branch ignores entries (`unheld.set(key, held)` replaced by `void held`, blob `004bb0c7c0f6 -> 21619f29c539`, anchor 1 -> 0). Only the S1 test goes red (`expected { inserted: 756 } to deeply equal { inserted: 755 }`), 5 pass. Restored: blob == HEAD `004bb0c7c0f6`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Seed refusals now carry the seed loader's sentence (`Failed to write OBJECT record #N (id=ID): …`) and no `code`, because the door's `errorList` names none. `seedDifference` and the scorecard read them unchanged.
- In the re-run, the replayed ask turns score `Run-问数 3/13` and `Run-operations 2/6`. Those answers were recorded over the old 173-row seed and are now graded against the full truth. This is not a regression: the old round had 8 turns not measured, and those turns are now asked.
- Not exercised live: the write-back restore (`restoreSeededRows`). Ask mode took the fresh-copy route, whose copy seeded alike. The write-back restore is covered by the unit test and its ablation.

## Verification

Condition 1 asked whether `data[]` keeps the card's ids as lookup targets. I measured it before writing code, on a blank 18.5.0 host with the kept `template.json` installed, through `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` (`installMode: 'managed'`):

- M1, the template plus the card seed as `data[]` (`externalId: 'id'`, `mode: 'insert'`): `seeded.mode inline, inserted 757, errors 0`. The ids are kept: `c001` exists, `ln_001_hotel.claim = c001`, `dep_eng.manager = e05`.
- M2, a separate data-only package with trip `t001` broken (end before start): `inserted 751, errors 11`. The trip is refused with the rule's message, and its claim, two lines and two steps go with it (two entries per dependent row: write plus lookup).
- M3: `owner_id` and the `user` field carry persona user ids as sent, and the employee persona reads its own 10 claims. A second data-only package with its own namespace installs. The same namespace again is refused with 422.

Condition 3 is the re-run on the round's kept build. That is `template.json`, sha256 `b7ab31a715d4e83c…`, in ask mode with the round's recorded ask turns (`--driver recorded:…/issue-34687/ask-round-2026-11-17/proof-managed/ask.rec.json`, `--create-version 18.5.0`). The record is on the project mount: `issue-34897/rerun-replay/` (`rerun.sh`, `run.log`, `started`, `exit`, `out/2026-11-17-scenario-travel_expense.json`).

- It started at 2026-11-17T21:19:04Z on runner head 8308c29888e5 and exited with `EXIT=0` at 21:22:39Z.
- Template: `installMode managed`, after the unmanaged attempt was refused `422 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`.
- Seed: `inserted 757, refused [], secondPass {demotravel_department.manager: 4}`. The scorecard reads `seed {inserted 757, total 757, refused 0}`.
- Before: the same build seeded through the data API refused 114 claims at the root and 470 lines and steps in cascade, 584 of 757 rows. Now 0 of the 114 root rows are refused, and all 470 cascaded rows are inserted.
- What changed after 8308c29 does not touch this path: the README, the changeset, and the message of a refused seed package, which this run never met.
